    Instructions:

    Summary

    Bound by her pure-blood family's rigid expectations, Andromeda Black's world is upended by Ted Tonks, a cheerful Hufflepuff whose simple kindness puts a crack in her carefully constructed facade. With each "accidental" meeting, she begins to question everything, realizing the boy her family despises is the only one who makes her feel human.
